prompt: spring security PortMapperImpl default HTTP HTTPS port mappings
answer:
Spring Security `PortMapperImpl` defaults to these HTTP → HTTPS port mappings:

| HTTP | HTTPS |
|---:|---:|
| 80 | 443 |
| 8080 | 8443 |

These mappings can be overridden using `setPortMappings(Map<String, String>)`.
